topic.title: AI Functionality
topic.shortdesc: Users with the Author platform user role can use AI-assisted features in to support writing, editing, and content improvement tasks.

body.p: When AI-assisted features are available, users with the Author platform user role can use them to support content creation and refinement. These features are intended to help with writing tasks, content improvement, and other authoring activities.
In , AI functionality is available through AI Positron. Availability depends on the product setup and the assigned platform user role.

section.title: Availability
section.p: AI functionality is intended for users with the Author platform user role. It may also depend on whether the feature is enabled and configured in the current environment.
